notes: Contraction of technology-replace-0016. That revision's edit is derived (Sony's best-selling console, from three premises), so this removes its main stored premise: 'The PlayStation 2 is made by Sony' (console_made_by, a new functional relation with the inverse makes_console and the subproperty reading manufactured_by, both staged in staging/technology-delete-abox.RELATIONS.md, because manufactured_by in RELATIONS.md has no functional tag; the other premise, that the PlayStation 2 is the best-selling console in the world, stays). Cardinality question: Microsoft ('no' before, because a console has one maker; 'does not know' after). Related near is the inverse; related far binds the subject through its abbreviation PS2. Derived: two compositions that look up a fact stored about Sony by name (its country, the Walkman), through the removed fact. The revision's Xbox 360, Kinect, PlayStation 3 and release-year questions describe the new value and are not reused. Evidence of the premise and the Walkman fact is copied from the revision; new phrases are in count_requests.
